Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 21045 of 2019
Applicant :- Mayank Gupta And 6 Others
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Ram Chandra Solanki,Sushil Kumar Dubey Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Ram Ashish Pandey Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
1. Heard Sri Ram Chandra Solanki, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Ram Ashish Pandey,
learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and Sri Prem Prakash Tripathi, learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. was filed seeking quashing of the entire proceedings of Case No. 3858 of 2018 (State vs. Mayank Gupta and Others), arising out of Case Crime No. 183 of 2017 u/S 498A, 323, 324, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S.- Ekdil, District- Etawah, pending in the Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Court No. 4, Etawah.

sentences.text:
has arisen out of the matrimonial discord between the applicant no.1 and opposite party no.2.
4.
Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 submits that he has no objection with regard to the prayer for settlement of dispute through mediation.
5. In view thereof, the instant application is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to the applicants to approach the Trial Court for referring the dispute for mediation.

If such an application is moved within two weeks from today, the same shall be considered by the Trial Court in accordance with law and the matter may be referred for mediation before the Mediation Centre at the district court concerned.
6.

Till the period of two weeks from today and if the application for referring the matter for mediation is filed by the applicants within that period, till the period of six weeks from the date of filing of application no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants.
If no application for mediation is filed within two weeks, there shall be no protection to the applicants.
